checks.name: asset-tier
checks.evidence: Tier C: exact interactive UI is the correct medium; no third-party or generated commercial assets.

checks.name: type-check
checks.evidence: pnpm run type-check: Next route type generation and TypeScript completed on 2026-09-10.

checks.name: lint
checks.evidence: pnpm run lint passed after fixing one unescaped JSX apostrophe.

checks.name: unit-and-contract-tests
checks.evidence: Full suite 48/48 passed. After keyboard focus restoration, all 31 affected template/export/contract tests passed again; final type check and lint also passed. Tests cover six round trips, malformed/version/direction/copy failures, exact UTF-8 size limits and exclusion of foreign runtime metadata/prototype keys.

checks.name: anti-slop-heuristic
checks.evidence: Canonical scanner: 100/100 for the repo. This keyword heuristic is not a visual quality score.

checks.name: secret-intake
checks.evidence: Repo scan found ten generic-key matches, all inside ignored .next cache/server manifests. No findings outside generated .next. Values were redacted; no global hook or scanner rule was disabled.

checks.name: production-build
checks.evidence: Final pp admission BOUNDED, 11935 MB available. Final pnpm run build passed compilation, TypeScript and all 26 generated pages, including six study and six editor routes. Both new route families use generateStaticParams and dynamicParams=false.

checks.name: prerender-contract
checks.evidence: All twelve generated study/editor HTML files have the expected data-template, exactly one h1 and noindex, nofollow. This is server HTML evidence, not browser, HTTP-404 or visual QA.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: Browser admission BOUNDED. Chrome disconnected during the loop; the available in-app browser needs its own Vercel login. Temporary access was queued in the app without committing a signed URL. No new local server was started.

checks.name: offline-brief-export
checks.evidence: Six Markdown briefs, six JSON configurations, an index and SHA-256 receipts exported by pnpm run template:briefs. Two added tests verify contents, repeatability, preservation of prior edits and packaging inclusion; 24 template/export/contract tests pass.

checks.name: immutable-source-package
checks.evidence: 63 files packaged from aa73e34c300fe9de896a5c8e7d537bd34d6a3978 with file hashes and archive checksum. Status PACKAGED_NOT_RELEASED; packaging does not assert application or launch verification.

checks.name: independent-buyer-critic
checks.evidence: Machine preflight pauses new swarms; no second-provider critique was claimed or fabricated.

checks.name: audio-origin-boundary
checks.evidence: 32 affected tests pass on Node 22, including same-origin blob acceptance and rejection of malformed, remote, data, JavaScript and foreign-origin blob URLs. TypeScript and scoped ESLint pass. Fresh CodeQL still pending; no alert suppressed.

refinement.strongest: Distinct information structures plus real, honestly labeled local actions.
refinement.weakest: No visual inspection yet, so typography, narrow-screen composition and playback behavior cannot be approved.
